view_method: Both specified original files were visually inspected with tools.view_image. File hashes were read with Get-FileHash.
comparison_basis: Candidate pixels represent the 618 by 824 logical viewport at 1x. The reference represents the same logical viewport at 2x; visual size comparisons account for this scale difference.

observed.candidate: The reader menu has a visible top status row: 18:46 at the left, and a Wi-Fi symbol, 87% text, and an outlined battery icon at the right.
observed.reference: The reference presents the same time and the Wi-Fi, battery percentage, and battery icon in its top status row.
observed.conclusion: All four previously requested status elements are visible in the candidate.

observed.candidate: The rightmost bottom toolbar action has three distinct horizontal dots above its More label.
observed.reference: The reference More action also uses three horizontal dots above the label.
observed.conclusion: The bottom More ellipsis is visibly present.

observed.candidate: The bottom chapter-navigation row shows the chapter 35 action at the left and the chapter 33 action at the right, with clear whitespace between them and no extra central short horizontal stroke.
observed.reference: The reference chapter-navigation row likewise has open whitespace between its left and right chapter actions.
observed.conclusion: The unwanted stroke between the bottom chapter-navigation buttons is absent. This observation concerns that row only.

observed.candidate: The upper-right header Table of Contents action is a visibly bulleted list: three separate dots precede three horizontal strokes. Its visual width is approximately 18 logical pixels, rather than a compact unbulleted 11-pixel mark.
observed.reference: After accounting for the reference's 2x scale, its upper-right header action has the same recognizable bulleted-list form and comparable logical size.
observed.conclusion: The header action now has the requested bulleted-list appearance. No panel opening was needed or performed.

coverage_note: This case belongs to the full review already. This supplementary prior-finding recheck adds no required reviewed case IDs.
limitations: Only the two assigned screenshots and the assigned case metadata were inspected.
